Name: Clint Sells Bars.
Author: Willdan12
Description:
[center]
[b][size=6][color=#e67e22]Clint Sells Bars[/color][/size][/b]
[size=4]Allows Clint to sell bars directly in Stardew Valley![/size]
[/center]

[line]

[heading]📖 Description[/heading]
[b]Clint Sells Bars[/b] (Version 1.0.0) is a simple yet extremely useful mod developed by Willdan12. Based on the mod data, Clint now also sells Copper, Iron, Gold, and Iridium Bars. No more struggling to smelt all your ores when you need materials quickly!

[heading]✨ Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Expanded Shop Stock:[/b] Clint now also sells Copper, Iron, Gold, and Iridium Bars directly at his shop.[/*]
[*][b]Quality of Life:[/b] Saves valuable time and resources for busy farmers.[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI Ready:[/b] Fully compatible with modern SMAPI environments.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]🛠️ Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (Minimum version: [b]4.0.0 [/b]or newer)[/*]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b] (Latest version compatible with SMAPI)[/*]
[/list]
[heading]📥 Installation Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] installed on your system.[/*]
[*]Download the [b]Clint Sells Bars[/b] mod file from this NexusMods page.[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded zip file.[/*]
[*]Move the extracted folder into the [b]Mods[/b] directory of your Stardew Valley game folder[/*]
[*]Launch your game using [b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[/list]
[heading]🙏 Shout Outs[/heading]
[list]
[*]Huge thanks to the [b]SMAPI[/b] development team.[/*]
[*]Thank you to the Stardew Valley community for the wonderful support.[/*]
[*]And thank you for downloading and trying out this mod![/*]
[/list]
[center]
[b]If you enjoy this mod, please don't forget to leave an Endorse 💚![/b]
[/center]
